entries.name: Ammonium bifluoride
entries.usefulness: Proposed ICM role: reagent for glass surface treatment and optical component processing; no game recipe, dose or performance is implied.

sources.title: Sigma-Aldrich 01110: Ammonium hydrogen difluoride
sources.supporting_text: Product identity lists NH4HF2 and ammonium bifluoride as a synonym.
sources.license_basis: Uncopyrightable factual identity/original paraphrase only, no copied tables

facts.value: The original glass-treatment patent includes ammonium bifluoride as an ingredient in a bath intended to give transparent glass a less reflective etched surface.

sources.title: US3551228A: Glass etching composition and method of preparing nonreflective glass, published 1970-12-29
sources.supporting_text: The original patent names ammonium bifluoride among components of its glass-etching bath and identifies it as the preferred ammonium ingredient.

entries.name: Sodium aluminate (anhydrous NaAlO2)
entries.usefulness: Proposed ICM role: alumina/caustic processing intermediate and coagulant supply chain. Do not treat aqueous aluminate species or commercial alkaline solutions as this pure anhydrous identity.

sources.title: NOAA CAMEO Chemicals: Sodium aluminate, solid; version 3.1.0 rev 1
sources.supporting_text: The identity page lists sodium metaaluminate (NaAlO2); only that defined anhydrous formula unit is represented here, not every trade mixture on the page.
sources.license_basis: Uncopyrightable factual identity/original paraphrase only, no copied tables

facts.value: Sodium aluminate is used to coagulate drinking-water impurities, particularly in low-alkalinity water, and may be combined with alum for pH and alkalinity control.

sources.title: Australian Drinking Water Guidelines: Sodium aluminate; endorsed 2005
sources.supporting_text: The treatment guidance describes coagulation, use with alum for alkalinity/pH adjustment, and production using aluminium oxide and excess caustic soda. Its Na2Al2O4 formula has the same reduced stoichiometry as NaAlO2.
sources.license_basis: Uncopyrightable factual identity/original paraphrase only, no copied tables

facts.value: The drinking-water guidance describes manufacture by combining aluminium oxide with excess caustic soda.

entries.name: Lithium chloride
entries.usefulness: Proposed ICM role: preparation of lithium-exchanged zeolite media for oxygen separation and a distinct liquid-desiccant drying option. Existing unverified lithium chloride identity must be reconciled rather than duplicated.

sources.title: Sigma-Aldrich 746460: Lithium chloride, anhydrous
sources.supporting_text: The anhydrous product identity gives LiCl, CAS 7447-41-8.

facts.value: Lithium chloride solutions are used in humidity-control and drying equipment.

sources.title: Albemarle: Industrial Processes; Gas and Air Treatment
sources.supporting_text: The manufacturer identifies lithium chloride solutions for humidity control/drying and lithium-chloride-brine-produced Li-zeolites for oxygen pressure-swing adsorption.

facts.value: Lithium chloride brine is used to produce lithium zeolites employed in pressure-swing adsorption for medical oxygen production; the zeolite material is a separate identity from LiCl.

entries.name: Ethanolamine
entries.usefulness: Proposed ICM role: a regenerable acid-gas absorption loop alongside solid adsorption media. Regeneration conditions and quantitative capacities require separate evidence before implementation.

sources.title: Sigma-Aldrich 398136: Ethanolamine
sources.supporting_text: The identity lists NH2CH2CH2OH, InChI composition C2H7NO, and monoethanolamine as a synonym.

facts.value: Monoethanolamine is supplied as an acid-gas-removal solvent.

entries.name: Sodium metabisulfite
entries.usefulness: Proposed ICM role: an industrial reducing reagent and bleaching consumable. This source slice does not establish a universal gas-purification capacity or equate it with sodium sulfite.

sources.title: Thermo Fisher: Sodium Metabisulfite, Fisher Chemical, S244
sources.supporting_text: The identity gives Na2O5S2 and synonyms sodium pyrosulfite/disulfite; this is the same elemental stoichiometry as Na2S2O5.

facts.value: Sodium metabisulfite is used as a reducing agent in chemical and pharmaceutical processing.

entries.name: Zinc chloride (anhydrous)
